title: Neil Armstrong's first step: remember the preparation
description:
Original historical commentary: Neil Armstrong takes his first lunar step on July 20, 1969. A famous moment reminds us to value preparation. Archival footage: NASA. No NASA or astronaut endorsement is implied. #Shorts #Motivation #Apollo11

'Ascension' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
Source: https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/ascension/

Music excerpt trimmed, faded and mixed beneath original narration.
